name: image-dataset-curator-alan-vo
summary: Inspects uploaded images for perceptual duplicates, EXIF privacy issues, and dimension quality; curates stratified train/val/test splits using deterministic hashing; and exports ML-ready JSONL/CSV/COCO manifests.
workflows: Upload and analyse images for dimensions, EXIF metadata privacy risks, perceptual hash fingerprints, and image quality scores
Detect near-duplicate images across datasets using pHash Hamming-distance comparison and mark duplicates for curation
Assign deterministic or seeded-random train/val/test splits and export ML-ready manifests in JSONL, CSV, or COCO-lite format
